As a ReelMetrics subscriber, you have direct access to the world's largest repository of slot design and performance data. We give you the statistical power to skip the trial and error and get it right the first time. Purchase the best products, implement optimum configs and market to the most receptive player segments.

ReelMetrics ranks all titles on record and constantly scans your mix for optimization opportunities. We alert you to great games that you’re missing, poor games that can't be fixed and underperforming games requiring re-configuration.

Slots can have hundreds or even thousands of configuration options per title. Using giant slugs of data and brute force math, ReelMetrics guides you to the denom, hold, location and other settings proven to maximize revenue yield.

We segment product by consumption patterns, highlighting how specific player segments respond to individual slot titles. This enables you to market the right product to the right segments, thereby boosting player productivity, satisfaction and loyalty.

To access ReelMetrics data, your casino must also contribute data. How do we keep your confidential data confidential? We don’t collect it. All performance data are anonymized and encrypted in your data center, by your personnel, using technologies that you already own.

Using instructions provided by ReelMetrics, your IT personnel implement scripts that anonymize, encrypt and transfer data at scheduled intervals. No black box applications and nothing to certify. You’re always in complete control of your data.

When it comes to reconciling & normalizing slot data, there’s little we can’t handle. With stratospheric reconciliation rates & unique IDs and standardized naming for each game title on-record, you can rest assured that all analytical comparisons are apple-to-apple.

We trust in curiosity, intellectual honesty and empirical truths. We use Big Data and scientific method to foster a deeper understanding of slot consumption and the human proclivity to gamble. Star Scout estimates the probability (low / medium / high / very high) that newly-released titles will become Stars. It does so by comparing each title's consumption tendencies 90 days post-release and comparing them to those of proven Stars during equivalent stages of their lifecycles. There's a bit more to it, naturally, but that's the basic framework.

The table below displays historical Star assessments (located between the red lines) on a title-by-title basis as well as the months during which the title(s) achieved Star status. Please note that performance criteria for Star status are both lofty and strict and that many titles receiving “High” or “Medium” assessments may exhibit performance that’s well in excess of floor average.
